items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Well, I like St. Cyr's style a great deal.

ctx.x: Any banjo players? That's what I would like.

Well, I like St. Cyr's style a great deal. Of course, he's a six-string man. And I really like Blanche Murrow's style. It was very, very straight, but it certainly was tremendous in adding to the beat because the rest of the rhythm section worked the same way. I think it's very important to have a rhythm section for everybody working together.
